$comment: Hand-maintained corrections of the kOS database, deep-merged last by tools/kos-db. Objects merge, other values replace, null removes. Only for what neither the kOS C# nor its documentation states correctly.

body.doc:
The celestial body of the given name.

```kerboscript
SET MUN_ORBIT TO BODY("Mun"):ORBIT.
```

params.name: inc|pos
params.doc: inclination in degrees, or the position relative to the center of the body

params.name: sma|body
params.doc: semi-major axis, or the body to orbit around

params.name: lan|ut
params.doc: longitude of ascending node in degrees, or the universal time

params.name: mEp
params.doc: mean anomaly at epoch, in degrees

createOrbit.doc:
Creates an orbit from its elements, `CREATEORBIT(inc, e, sma, lan, argPe, mEp, t, body)`, or from a state vector, `CREATEORBIT(pos, vel, body, ut)`.

```kerboscript
SET myOrbit TO CREATEORBIT(-0, 0, 270000, 0, 0, 0, 0, Mun).
SET myOrbit TO CREATEORBIT(V(2295.5, 0, 0), V(0, 0, 70000 + Kerbin:RADIUS), Kerbin, 0).
```

angleDiff.doc: The signed difference between two angles, from `a` to `b`, in degrees, in the range [-180, 180].

print.doc: Prints a value to the terminal. Usually written as the `PRINT` statement: `PRINT "Hello".`

printAt.doc: Prints a value at a column and line of the terminal. Usually written as the statement `PRINT value AT (col, line).`

params.name: delaySeconds
params.doc: how long the message stays on screen

params.name: style
params.doc: where to show it: 1 upper left, 2 upper center, 3 upper right, 4 lower center

params.name: doEcho
params.doc: also echo the message to the terminal as `HUD: message`

clearScreen.doc: Clears the terminal. Usually written as the `CLEARSCREEN.` statement.

add.doc: Adds a maneuver node to the flight plan. Usually written as the `ADD node.` statement.

remove.doc: Removes a maneuver node from the flight plan. Usually written as the `REMOVE node.` statement.

logFile.doc: Appends text to a file. Usually written as the `LOG text TO path.` statement.

reboot.doc: Restarts the CPU, running the boot file again. Usually written as the `REBOOT.` statement.

shutdown.doc: Turns the CPU off. Usually written as the `SHUTDOWN.` statement.

constant.doc: The `Constant` structure of physical and mathematical constants. Kept for compatibility: use the bound variable `CONSTANT` instead.

params.name: listType
params.doc: what to list, as in `LIST listType IN variable.`

buildList.doc: The list that the statement `LIST listType IN variable.` would build, e.g. `BUILDLIST("engines")`.

params.name: time
params.doc: universal time, in seconds or as a `TimeStamp`

params.name: time
params.doc: universal time, in seconds or as a `TimeStamp`

params.name: time
params.doc: universal time, in seconds or as a `TimeStamp`

params.name: time
params.doc: universal time of the node, in seconds or as a `TimeStamp`

stage.doc: The `Stage` structure of the current stage of the CPU vessel, used to count resources in the current stage. Not to be confused with the `STAGE.` command, which activates the next stage.

opcodesLeft.doc: The number of instructions the CPU can still run in the current physics tick before it must wait for the next one.

steering.doc: Where the cooked steering points the ship: a `Direction`, a `Vector`, or the string `"kill"` to stop the rotation. Usually set with `LOCK STEERING TO expression.`

activeShip.doc: The vessel that is currently under the player's control, which can differ from `SHIP`, the vessel of the CPU running the script.

obt.doc: Shortcut for `SHIP:OBT`, the current orbit of the ship.

orbit.doc: Shortcut for `SHIP:ORBIT`, the current orbit of the ship.

sessionTime.doc: The number of seconds since the CPU was turned on, as a real number.

steeringManager.doc: The `SteeringManager` of the CPU vessel, which tunes how the cooked steering controls the ship.

version.doc: The version of kOS running the script.

ag1.doc: Action group 1. Set it, or use `ON`, `OFF` and `TOGGLE`, to trigger the group.

ag2.doc: Action group 2. Set it, or use `ON`, `OFF` and `TOGGLE`, to trigger the group.

Addons.doc: The addons kOS can talk to, each a suffix of `ADDONS`: `ADDONS:RT` (RemoteTech), `ADDONS:TR` (Trajectories), `ADDONS:KAC` (Kerbal Alarm Clock), `ADDONS:AGX` (Action Groups Extended). Other mods can add their own.

available.doc: Whether the addon of that name is installed and usable.

hasAddon.doc: Whether kOS knows an addon of that name.

liquidFuel.doc: The amount of liquid fuel on the vessel. kOS reads any resource this way, by its name without spaces, including the resources of mods.
